meaning:
ἴαμα, -τος, τό
(ἰάομαι), [in LXX for מַרְפֵּא (2Ch.36:16, Ecc.10:4, Jer.33:6, etc. ;]
1. most frequently in cl., a means of healing, remedy (Thuc., al.; Wis.11:4 10:9).
2. = ἴασις (which see), a healing (Plat.; Jer, l.with): pl., 1Co.12:9 12:28 12:30.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: to another faith, by the same Spirit; and to another gifts of healings, by the same Spirit;
